---
title: "Indicators"
---

```{r setup}
library(fhperf)
built <- readRDS("_data/indicators.rds")
tab <- merge(built$table, built$summaries[, setdiff(names(built$summaries), "target")], by = "id", sort = FALSE)
tab <- tab[order(match(tab$domain, domain_codes(built$catalogue)), tab$id), ]
```

Statistical process control charts for the
[Fake NHS Trust synthetic hospital dataset](https://thomuk.github.io/synthetic-hospital-data/),
built from the **`r built$scale`** set covering
`r format(built$window[1], "%B %Y")` to `r format(built$window[2], "%B %Y")`.
Each indicator is defined by one or two components, each a SQL query that
returns one row per event; the package counts or sums them by month and
plots the result with
[NHSRplotthedots](https://nhs-r-community.github.io/NHSRplotthedots/).
The [index](catalogue.qmd) lists every indicator with its numerator and
denominator ids; [how it works](about.qmd) explains the structure.

```{r table}
#| results: asis
icon <- function(variation) gsub("_", " ", gsub("special_cause_", "", variation))
for (dom in unique(tab$domain)) {
  rows <- tab[tab$domain == dom, ]
  cat("\n## ", rows$domain_title[1], " (`", dom, "`)\n\n", sep = "")
  out <- data.frame(
    Id = sprintf("`%s`", rows$id),
    Indicator = sprintf("[%s](indicators/%s.qmd)", rows$title, rows$id),
    Type = rows$type,
    Latest = format(rows$period, "%b %Y"),
    Value = mapply(function(v, id) format_value(v, get_indicator(built$catalogue, id)), rows$value, rows$id),
    Variation = icon(rows$variation),
    Target = ifelse(is.na(rows$target), "", mapply(function(v, id) format_value(v, get_indicator(built$catalogue, id)), rows$target, rows$id)),
    Assurance = ifelse(is.na(rows$assurance), "", rows$assurance),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  print(knitr::kable(out, row.names = FALSE))
  cat("\n")
}
```

```{r charts}
#| fig-height: 4
#| results: asis
for (id in tab$id) {
  cat("\n### ", built$table$title[built$table$id == id], " (`", id, "`) {.unnumbered}\n\n", sep = "")
  print(plot_indicator(built$indicators[[id]], icons_size = 6))
  cat("\n")
}
```

Built `r format(built$built_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z")`.
